revisions.payload_text: The delay to control building was neither foreseeable at tender nor within the Contractor's control, based on the documents reviewed.

revisions.author: James Okonkwo
revisions.payload_text: The evidence establishes that the jetty topsides interface was not released for construction until well after the planned start.

revisions.author: T. Nakamura
revisions.payload_text: As shown in teh record, the commissioning activity absorbed its available float by the June update update and thereafter drove the forecast completion date. As shown in the record, the piling activity absorbed its available float by the April update update and thereafter drove the forecast completition date.
